entries.title: DRAFT: exact source quantifiers for C0052
entries.statement: DRAFT source correction, not a solution. For zero-field nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic Ising on Z^3, Duminil-Copin's Conjecture 6 defines g_3(beta)=sum_{x2,x3,x4} U4(0,x2,x3,x4)/(chi(beta)^2 xi(beta)^3) using the subcritical free infinite-volume state. It calls the model nontrivial when g_3(beta) does not tend to zero as beta increases to beta_c. Since U4<=0, this asks for a sequence beta_n increasing to beta_c with -g_3(beta_n)>=epsilon for some epsilon>0. A positive full liminf or non-Gaussianity of every subsequential scaling field is a stronger quantified route. Current 2026 openness is UNKNOWN in this packet.
assumptions: zero-field nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic Ising on Z^3

source.excerpt: If g(β) tends to 0 as β ↗ βc, the field is said to be trivial. Otherwise, it is said to be non-trivial.

entries.title: DRAFT: associated spin field with anomalous power-law covariance and Gaussian limit
entries.statement: DRAFT scoped boundary result; written proof independently checked by w476, served-model diversity gate pending. For each 0<gamma<3, take a stationary unit-variance Gaussian field G on Z^3 with covariance R_gamma(z)=(1+|z|^2)^(-gamma/2), and set sigma_x=sign(G_x). The bounded spin field is stationary, spin-flip symmetric, positively associated, has two-point covariance (2/pi)arcsin R_gamma(z) asymptotic to (2/pi)|z|^(-gamma), and has on-site fourth cumulant -2. Yet for each finite list of compactly supported smooth tests f, the normalized sums N^(-3+gamma/2) sum_x f(x/N)sigma_x converge jointly to a centered Gaussian vector with covariance (2/pi) double_integral f(u)h(v)|u-v|^(-gamma) du dv. This refutes only a proposed implication from association, anomalous two-point decay and a local fourth cumulant to non-Gaussian smeared limits. The field is not shown to be a nearest-neighbor Ising Gibbs state or to satisfy random-current identities.
assumptions: finite list of fixed compactly supported smooth tests
